scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm start --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
